name: Country Alter UI
description: Provides an interface to alter the built in country names and codes.
project_description: Country Alter UI adds an admin settings form under Configuration → Regional and language that reworks the built-in Drupal country list. From one page an administrator can add or override country entries (code|name pairs), filter out specific countries by ISO code, and optionally sort the resulting list alphabetically. The changes are applied through a hook_countries_alter() implementation, so every place that uses core's country manager (country fields, the Address module's country selector, etc.) reflects the customized list without code changes.
